title: Van Ness Recreation Center – Approval of Revised On-site Facility Signage
text:
Van Ness Recreation Center – Approval of Revised On-site Facility Signage

  Proposed by the Children’s Collective, Inc. for Van Ness Child Care Center
summary: The commission will approve revised on-site signage proposed by Children's Collective for the Van Ness Child Care Center at Van Ness Recreation Center.
